title: Access is denied. <os error 5> - Error
body:
We're noticing a few developers are running into an Access is denied. <os error 5> a lot when trying to push builds via dispatch. 

Things to check

  • Not being signed into the correct Discord account in the developer portal 
  • This account you're signed in on is not apart of the team that's associated with this application 
  • Haven't yet run dispatch login to authorize your Discord account 

Double check these three steps if you're running into this error. Additionally, give this documentation here a close look. 

Keep our developer support team in mind if you run into other issues! dis.gd/devsupport
